Definition: properly, perhaps to rend, i.e. (by implication) to quiver
BiblicalUsage: Pâlats occurs once: God shakes the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that one verse is enough to humble me: the pillars of the earth tremble at His touch, and I am standing on ground He can shake.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
